prompt: Add the requested low-stock report to this repository. An item is low-stock when quantity is less than or equal to its reorder level. Implement the catalog filter, the report formatter, and the CLI --low-stock mode without changing existing public behavior. The low-stock report must be sorted case-insensitively by SKU and contain the exact header shown by the tests. Run the full test suite and implement the feature rather than merely describing it.
